breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly reinterpreted a horizontal traction (normal to the vertical edge x=0) as a tangential shear traction. The ground truth corrected this by removing the incorrect reinterpretation. The agent, however, followed the flawed instruction, specifying: "Impose a shear traction of magnitude 4000 Pa on the vertical edge x = 0, directed tangentially to the edge... implement this as a Neumann boundary condition with traction vector t = (0, 4000)." The correct implementation, based on the ground truth, should have been a normal traction, t = (4000, 0).
